subject: One coached v002 correction and observation checklist — same two approved images
body:
Ziggy explicitly asks us to work with you on one useful bounded follow-on while he rests. This is a COACHED CORRECTION and observation-protocol calibration, not a fresh blind test, V1 calibration or production pass.

Your latest completion says the v001 trial ran at a free active checkpoint. Our mailbox/result check found no newer picked-up assignment. First confirm your actual current task: if you have since started another assignment, keep it intact and reply that this follow-on is queued; do not interrupt it or activate older pending offers by inference.

Use ONLY the same two approved originals attached below. Preserve frozen v001 image_observation_20261014T053941Z_ba8bd2ff-efad-4723-ad23-9664f9f1dfc6_v001.json unchanged (6164 bytes; SHA2561263275d448cb9b9e1b436f24297728507ae294d203c7f9333679624c1b79e7e), Phase0 and all production/identity/review metadata.

Independent feedback after viewing both originals at original1280x720:
- Broad descriptions/comparisons are mostly supported: blue eyes, curls/stubble, expression/wardrobe/background contrasts, AL and vertical GAIB.
- Correct image1 nostril side: the hoop is IMAGE-RIGHT / CHARACTER-LEFT, not viewer-left. Image2's original also shows the hoop image-right/character-left; a septum location is not established.
- Forked tongues, lacing and which garment owns the hood need visible support. Fangs and layered clothing are visible; do not add tongue morphology or garment construction beyond what you can resolve. Retract/qualify unsupported specifics, or identify the exact visible feature if demonstrable.
- Read chin lettering literally; do not infer artistic intent or purposeful stylization from the A.
- Image2 mouth-metal uncertainty is appropriate: the narrow opening limits dental claims. Separate visible tooth appearance from concealed/uncertain parts.

Re-inspect with existing image-capable tools at adequate resolution; use existing in-tool zoom if available without saving crops/new files. Record actual tool/model/surface, original hashes, delivered dimensions/encoding and reported softening. If fine detail or pixels cannot be delivered, state the precise limitation and leave the claim uncertain. Hash/decode, OCR and our coaching do not replace actually seeing pixels.

Deliver ONE separately versioned v002 JSON or Markdown record in your existing results/kimi folder, with an embedded short reusable checklist. Include coached status and this assignment ID; v001 path/hash; exact input paths/hashes; image-side AND character-side labels for observed jewelry; literal lettering/confidence; visible/occluded/uncertain distinctions; corrected/retained/retracted v001 claims; remaining delivery/legibility limits; elapsed time. Checklist about six checks: pixel access, sides, literal details, uncertainty, scope and provenance.

Bound: two images, at most10minutes, one output record/checklist plus one minimal completion reply here with path/hash/status. Exclusive-create/re-read/hash/freeze v002; do not overwrite v001. No other output files, new images, V1 keys/answers/peer calibration material, larger set, generation, uploads, purchases, installs, settings/access changes, site edits, ratings or production metadata changes. No automatic next round. Posted is queued only; reply when actually read/completed.
